case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
title: Four Clearly Separated Flyer Blocks
tests: Checks exact text reproduction and four visibly separate text blocks rather than a merged paragraph or extra sections.

judge.summary: The flyer meets the brief with four clearly separated, legible text blocks on a dark blue portrait layout framed by warm lanterns.

must_haves.item: Exactly four text blocks are visibly separated by clear space.
must_haves.why: Four distinct text blocks appear in the requested order with clear gaps between them.

must_haves.item: The first block reads exactly 'NIGHT MARKET'.
The second block reads exactly '18 September 2027 | 18:00–22:00'.
must_haves.why: The date and time line matches the requested wording and punctuation.

must_haves.item: The third block reads exactly 'Old Mill Courtyard'.
must_haves.why: The venue line reads Old Mill Courtyard.

must_haves.item: The fourth block reads exactly 'Free entry • Everyone welcome'; there is no other wording.
must_haves.why: The final line matches the requested text, and no additional wording is visible.

must_haves.item: The flyer is portrait 4:5 with a dark blue background and warm lantern imagery; all four blocks are legible.
must_haves.why: The image has a 4:5 portrait format, a deep blue background, glowing amber lanterns, and readable cream-colored text.
